statement.notes: The primary statement provides a single, clear line item for 'Depreciation and amortization' for each year. No supplementary tables were required to construct this field. The values are extracted directly from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The scale is 1E6 (millions) as indicated in the statement header. The sign convention for this field is as presented in the statement, as it is an add-back to net income in the operating activities section.
